content.short: Solanart is an NFT marketplace on the Solana blockchain.
content.description: Since its 2021 launch, Solanart has been a Solana-based open NFT marketplace operating on the Solana blockchain. Users can purchase and sell Solana-based NFTs by connecting their wallets—Sollet, the Sollet Chrome extension, or Phantom. Developers can apply to list their work or participate in a launchpad program. Solanart is a zero-fee NFT trading platform, designed to enable simple, accessible trading for creators and collectors on Solana.
